finding.claim: typeof value never equals null, so null falls through the string/number/boolean check and reaches `value.buffer`, throwing TypeError on null input.
finding.title: isJSONSerializable crashes on null due to `t === null` check

verifier.reason: Confirmed: at src/utils.ts:22 `t === null` compares the string result of `typeof` to null and can never be true, so null (typeof "object") passes src/utils.ts:25, fails Array.isArray at src/utils.ts:28, and dereferences null at src/utils.ts:31 via `value.buffer`, throwing a TypeError.

repro.expectedBehavior: isJSONSerializable(null) returns true (null is JSON-serializable and was intended to hit the early true branch) without throwing
repro.rationale: typeof null is 'object', so the buggy `t === null` check never matches; null then reaches `value.buffer` and throws TypeError. Asserting it returns true fails on the buggy code via that throw.
repro.reason: test did not demonstrate the claim consistently
